model.stratum: Forward geometric realization and adjacent-frame attachment transport for a declared constant-turn candidate. Integer realization R levels, two [M|C] signed axes and one [C|M] signed axis, one reference XOR choice with M/C exchange on every R step, and optional tetrahedral cells of an elementary lattice prism, with every vertex bound to an actual node address.
consumes: Operator request to visualize empty structured space in the existing Three.js experiment
provides: Empty triangular patches on discrete realization R levels
Signed 2+1 typed axes with alternating roles from one R=0 reference choice
Retained axis identities under editable adjacent-level rotations
Lone P/N/E incidence cells and a three-cell lattice-prism partition with exact node bindings
missing_constructors: Source-derived assignment of C/M vertex types and particle transition operators, beyond the constructed geometric node bindings
model.next_falsifier: An axis receives a different rotation rule, an R level is noninteger, a lattice edge changes length under rotation, or a carrier vertex lacks its declared lattice-node address, cells overlap in their interiors, or a non-lattice rotation is silently repaired by snapping.
